|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Special Modifications (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Your starships may not be made 'immediately lost' during the weapons phase of a battle. May place Effect in Lost Pile to make your starship immune to attrition for remainder of turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Your starships about to be lost during the weapons segment of battle remain in play instead. May place this Effect in Lost Pile to make your starship immune to attrition for remainder of turn.” '''What changed:''' “may not” → “about to”; “made 'immediately lost'” → “lost”; “phase” → “segment”; “a battle.” → “battle remain in play instead.”; added “this”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 23. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Special Modifications]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Special Modifications (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Special Modifications]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_23.
